dartwork · categorical color

Every palette is a verified ladder.

24 categorical palettes, each built on an even-L* lightness ramp and checked for grayscale separability and color-vision safety. Hover a swatch for its hex and L*. Use as dc.vivid0…7 or dm.set_cycle("vivid").

Accessible 1

fixed CVD gold standard, shipped verbatim

dc.accessible Accessible · Okabe-Ito CVD gold standard

When colorblind-safety is mandatory — the proven CUD 8-color set.

B&W exempt CVD 14.8/14.0/11.0
Verification per palette — B&W ΔL* = min grayscale lightness gap; CVD d/p/t = min perceptual distance under deuter / protan / tritan vision (CAM02-UCS). Higher is safer. Diverging palettes are B&W-exempt by design (symmetric tent).
